name: nazaakat-website-tooling
description: Dev/QA tooling only — index.html itself remains a plain static file with no build step and no dependencies. This manifest exists solely so check-wrap-padding.mjs (and any future browser-based check) can be installed with a single `npm install`, which also provisions the Chromium binary via `postinstall` below — `npm install` alone does NOT do this for the playwright package by default, confirmed by testing; without this hook a fresh clone would need a second manual `npx playwright install chromium` step, which is exactly the kind of thing that gets forgotten.
